literal_source_claim_zh: 拉丁方的存在性与计数
literal_source_claim_en: Existence and counting of Latin squares.
statement_blocker: The catalog does not define Latin square, order, carrier conventions, boundary cases, the existence variant, or whether counting means total, reduced, quotient, exact, formulaic, bounded, or asymptotic enumeration. It also does not decide whether existence and counting are one conjunction or separate roots. Choosing these data would invent or substitute mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: the source must fix the order domain, row, column and symbol carriers, whether they are identical or equipotent, their finite structures, and the array, quasigroup, or orthogonal-array representation.
conclusion: Open: no exact existence range, construction, enumeration object, equivalence relation, formula, value, bound, divisibility statement, or asymptotic conclusion is selected.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; order zero, order one, empty or unequal carriers, vacuous row and column predicates, and reducedness conventions remain explicit statement tasks.
candidate_scope_not_credited: existence of a Latin square of every source-specified positive order, for example by a checked cyclic construction
the total labelled number L_n of Latin squares of order n
the reduced number R_n after first-row and first-column normalization
an exact general counting formula, a finite-order enumeration, a divisibility theorem, a bound, or an asymptotic result
counts modulo isomorphism, isotopy, type, or paratopy
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-0902 Euler's orthogonal-Latin-square conjecture or THM-M-0903 Bose-Shrikhande-Parker
partial Latin square completion or embedding, Latin rectangles, transversals, Sudoku, magic squares, or mutually orthogonal squares
a cyclic group-table construction presented as an enumeration theorem
one finite table of counts presented as a uniform formula or asymptotic theorem
a quasigroup, matrix, or record that assumes the Latin property as evidence of existence
the catalog's untrusted verified label or the discovery probe as human or machine proof evidence
